verdict.rationale: Xero offers JAX, an AI tool for invoicing and reconciliation using plain-language commands, plus an official MCP server enabling broader natural-language/agentic access to Xero data via AI assistants. However, JAX appears limited to specific workflows (invoicing, reconciliation) rather than full product operation via natural language, and there's no independent hands-on evidence confirming reliability across the full accounting feature set. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over the full breadth of Xero features (reporting, payroll, multi-currency, etc.), independent/hands-on validation of JAX or MCP-driven natural-language commands.
